title: Rockforce
summary: Rockforce is a spell that allows a Seeker to conjure a cascade of meteoric energy bolts. This spell manifests as an orange aura from the caster's hand which then produces a shower of meteor-like projectiles.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Rockforce was used by [[Hoffman]] against [[Dante Vale]] to try and stop him from entering [[the Professor's castle]]. Dante, however, easily dodged the spell by using [[Hyperstride]]. {{source|An Ally from the Organization}}
{{Clear}}

'''Rockforce''' is a spell that allows a [[Seeker]] to conjure a cascade of meteoric energy bolts. This spell manifests as an orange aura from the caster's hand which then produces a shower of meteor-like projectiles.

== History ==
Rockforce was used by [[Hoffman]] against [[Dante Vale]] to try and stop him from entering [[the Professor's castle]]. Dante, however, easily dodged the spell by using [[Hyperstride]]. {{source|An Ally from the Organization}}
